authorization: Root explicit approved_public_surface_batch_teacher true, exact driver SHA and every local input complete binding are required. Preparation authorizes no public payload access/download.

frame_schema.frame_id: unique inert public bundle identity, never used as an artifact path
frame_schema.provenance: optional inert JSON object; no pointers followed

caller_plan: Caller binds the predeclared complete public bundle list. Driver uses all listed frames, no source/group/pose/label/IoU/outcome selection. Coarse capture groups are not certified independent sessions.
fixed_math: Pinned geometry module only, parse xyz/triangles with material refs inert; no mesh scaling/axis correction/triangulation/pose fitting.
Original integer depth float64/1000; depth0 becomes NaN. SAM uint8 values must be 0/255. K3x3/T4x4 use pinned validation.
T is always main object-to-camera convention. T and inverseT diagnostics retained; no winner selection. Same near/epsilon/tolerances from pinned geometry.
Pinned surface compiler and exact original policy:11x11 valid/stable windows; D full SAM target and residual abs<=.05; E full SAM background and residual<=-.15; all else U.
Exact original r-grid stride8/offset4 and all9 q offsets preserved; shape480x640 yields4800r/43200q. Other listed shapes retain the same rule, no resize.
r state and q SAM presence remain separate; query_pixel_DE_gold null, emulated q never claimed as fresh initializer, native_slot null and SELF UNKNOWN.
streaming_and_failure: Per-frame files written under frames/F000000 by declared order; frame_id remains metadata.
Geometry validation/unsupported main render is explicit geometry UNKNOWN: missing main depth represented as NaN, unchanged compiler yields U; no fallback to inverseT.
Integrity/hash/decode/process failure gets FRAME_FAILURE and overall PASSfalse; listed frame remains in FRAME_INDEX and original STARTED plan. Other listed frames are attempted once, no retry.
Frame compilation PASS means deterministic processing, not registration correctness, geometry validity, physical gold or training admission.
Fresh output and exclusive writes; any partial output is preserved. Global fatal failure records all listed and attempted IDs.

per_frame_outputs.SURFACE_AUX_MAPS.npz: lossless labels int8 plus11 eligibility bool and8 reason bool maps
per_frame_outputs.REFERENCE_ALL.jsonl.gz: allr, deterministicgzip mtime0/filename empty, compressed and original UTF8-stream SHA/size/count
per_frame_outputs.QUERY_ALL.jsonl.gz: all9q perr with same deterministic compression and original-stream hashes
per_frame_outputs.GEOMETRY_DIAGNOSTIC.json: both T/inverseT IoU/depth residual/missing/support stats; inverseT arrays NOT_SAVED
per_frame_outputs.SUMMARY.json: oldpilot count/discordance fieldnames plus explicit geometry status/storage/noadmission
per_frame_outputs.COMPLETE.json: exact all per-frame outputbindings and original inputbindings

compatibility: Compiler r/q records are unchanged oldpilot schema; only storage is deterministic gzip and lossless NPZ. Existing oldpilot outputs are preserved and not read by this driver.
